about: What the OLD page (interface/scripts/main.js, 2.0.0-player.14) sent from its two Find buttons, captured in headless Brave against live MusicBrainz on 2026-10-02, BEFORE 2.0.0-player.15 moved both onto ui/src/lib/releasePayload.ts. `group` is the release group as /search_musicbrainz/fully_search answered it, `pressings` the releases the card or row was built from (trimmed to the fields the builders read), `expected` the exact body openCandidates was handed. payload.sim.cjs holds the new builder to every one. A row case keeps only its own release; a card case keeps every pressing, since representativeRelease chooses among them.
